thread:
jane.cust: Hey team — our rerank endpoint started returning 410 today after a morning deploy. Body: {"error":"model_deprecated", "message":"Model id redwood/rerank-bert-v2 is deprecated"}. We didn't touch client. Anyone seen this?

oliver: Can you paste a minimal repro (curl + response body)? Also which tenant?

jane.cust: Tenant: tenant-prod-42. Repro:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/rerank-bert-v2","queries":["q1","q2"],"candidates":["a","b"]}'
```
Response (410):
```json
{"error":"model_deprecated","message":"Model id redwood/rerank-bert-v2 is deprecated. See docs for migration."}
```

lucy: Thanks. Two common causes: 1) tenant-level alias was repointed / deprecated, 2) client is sending an old hard-coded model id instead of the current alias. Did you use an alias like `rerank-default` previously?

jane.cust: We used the model id directly in code (redwood/rerank-bert-v2) — legacy client. We thought that id was stable.

devon: We rolled an alias cleanup last night to remove unused model ids and enforce aliasing. Old model ids without explicit redirect return 410 to force migration. For tenant-prod-42 I see an alias mapping that now points to `redwood/rerank-bert-v3`.

oliver: Quick checks you can run: 
1) GET tenant alias list (internal API):
```bash
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN>' \n  'https://api.redwood.com/internal/tenants/tenant-prod-42/aliases'
```
Expected partial output:
```json
{"aliases": [{"name":"rerank-default","target":"redwood/rerank-bert-v3","updated_at":"2026-03-16T08:04:00Z"}]}
```
2) If your client caches model ids, clear the client cache / restart so it fetches aliases. We saw a few SDKs cache the literal model id for 24h.

lucy: Mitigations: 1) change client to reference the alias name (e.g., `rerank-default`) or the current canonical id `redwood/rerank-bert-v3`; 2) we can temporarily create a redirect from the deprecated id -> v3 for your tenant while you cut a release; 3) set header `X-Force-Model-Refresh: true` on the client to bypass local caches (supported in newest SDK).

jane.cust: Trying direct v3 now...

jane.cust: Updated request to model: "redwood/rerank-bert-v3" and retried. Response 200 with scores array. Partial response:
```json
{"scores":[0.78,0.22],"model":"redwood/rerank-bert-v3"}
```

jane.cust: That fixed it. Thanks.

devon: Follow-up: we'll add a short-term redirect for tenant-prod-42 so old clients receive a 302 + warning header instead of 410. We also logged an internal task to announce deprecations to tenants with active usage.

opsbot: INC-9872 created: "tenant-prod-42: add redirect for deprecated rerank id redwood/rerank-bert-v2" by devon.

lucy: I'll email the customer success contact to confirm they will roll the alias change into their next release. Please keep this thread updated if you see any other affected tenants. :thumbsup:

jane.cust: Great — appreciate the quick turnaround. :heart:
